categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes the mining interface methods and block template synchronization rather than IPC infrastructure itself (serialization, connection handling, or capnp toolchains).
categories.rationale: The IPC definition specifies that changes to what the mining interface exposes or how templates are built are mining-first and not IPC unless they touch IPC infrastructure itself.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Tagged Mining and modifies BlockTemplateManager, interfaces::Mining, and mining capnp definitions.
categories.rationale: Resolves a ThreadSanitizer-confirmed data race where concurrent IPC worker calls race on template modification and reads. Addressing race conditions during template inspection and solution submission is necessary for the stability and correctness of the external mining interface.
